title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend com forte experiência em Java e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos para atuar em um ambiente moderno, com foco em qualidade de código, escalabilidade e boas práticas de engenharia.

Se você gosta de discutir system design, identificar code smells antes que virem problema e trabalhar com microserviços em cloud, essa pode ser uma ótima oportunidade.

title: NodeJS Developer w/NextJS - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of professional experience as Software Developer;
  • 3+ years of professional experience with NodeJS;
  • 2 + years of professional experience with NextJS;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Trainee Designer
description:
Se você está iniciando sua carreira no design e quer aprender na prática, dentro de um ambiente inovador e em constante crescimento, essa oportunidade é para você! ✨

Uma empresa do setor de tecnologia (SaaS B2B) está buscando um(a) Trainee Designer criativo(a), curioso(a) e cheio(a) de vontade de evoluir. A atuação envolve apoio em projetos de branding, social media e comunicação interna.


O que você vai fazer

  • Criar artes para redes sociais, campanhas e materiais institucionais
  • Apoiar a construção e manutenção de identidade visual
  • Participar de brainstorms e contribuir em processos criativos
  • Desenvolver peças para comunicação interna e externa
  • Testar, aprender e evoluir constantemente dentro da área de design

title: Consultor Sênior - Engenheiro Elétrico - Auditoria Interna(GRC)
description:
Como trabalhar na Grant Thornton?

Aqui o aprendizado e o desenvolvimento são constantes. E o nosso espírito colaborativo faz toda a diferença para o seu crescimento individual e conquistas em equipe.

Nossos tempos são formados por pessoas e talentos, com trajetórias, habilidades únicas. Inovação que diversidade é essencial para o fortalecimento da nossa organização e dos nossos colaboradores, refletindo em melhores, promovendo e continuados para nossos clientes.

Se você é uma pessoa movida a desafios e determinado a fazer a diferença. Faça parte da nossa equipe!


Principais Responsabilidades/Atividades

  • Coordenar trabalhos de consultoria, auxiliando e engajando a equipe;
  • Demonstrar habilidade de planejamento;
  • Realizar treinamentos on-the-job de Trainees e Associates;
  • Executar controles analisando e identificando falhas internas;
  • Execução de processos, matriz de riscos e controles, condução de testes, elaboração de planos de ação;
  • Conhecimento em controles internos, COSO e SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley);
  • Atuação em projetos de auditoria e/ou consultoria;
  • Realização de auditorias de contratos - contratação, mediação e treinamento;
  • Realizar a revisão dos processos de negócios priorizados, identificando áreas de risco e oportunidades de implementação de auditoria contínua;
  • Documentar a especificação funcional dos testes a serem desenvolvidos pelo time técnico.

Experiências Necessárias

  • A partir de 3 anos em Auditoria Interna.
  • Vivência em empresas do setor elétrico.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino Superior Completo. Área de formação: Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Órgão de Classe Ativo.

Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office.
  • Inglês Intermediário.

Habilidades e Atitudes Desejáveis

  • Visão analítica / crítica
  • Organização
  • Comprometimento
  • Confidencialidade

title: SR Fullstack Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients.


We’re looking for a Senior FullStack Engineer with strong expertise in .NET, Azure, and modern frontend frameworks to join a dynamic and innovative team supporting Experian Employer Services. If you enjoy building scalable applications, working across the full stack, and contributing to cloud-native solutions this role is for you:

title: Cientista de dados - IA Generativa
description:
Buscamos Cientistas de Dados com foco e atuação em Inteligência Artificial , com experiência ou forte interesse em Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) .


A posição envolve atuar desde a compreensão do problema de negócio até a construção, experimentação e evolução de soluções baseadas em dados e IA, em colaboração próxima com times técnicos, de produto e áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de IA Generativa , utilizando LLMs e abordagens baseadas em RAG.
  • Desenvolver, testar e evoluir pipelines de dados e modelos para casos de uso com IA Generativa.
  • Conduzir experimentações e validações contínuas, avaliando qualidade, relevância e confiabilidade das soluções.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de tecnologia, produto e negócio ao longo de todo o ciclo da solução.
  • Apoiar a integração de modelos em ambientes produtivos, considerando escalabilidade, monitoramento e manutenção.
  • Documentar soluções, decisões técnicas e aprendizados do projeto.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como Cientista de Dados , atuando em projetos de machine learning e/ou inteligência artificial.
  • Vivência com IA Generativa (GenAI) , incluindo LLMs e arquiteturas RAG .
  • Forte capacidade analítica para exploração, preparação e interpretação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em programação aplicada à análise de dados e modelagem.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com dados em ambientes produtivos e em times multidisciplinares.
  • Boa comunicação para explicar conceitos técnicos a públicos não técnicos.

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
Estamos procurando uma pessoa de tecnologia de dados experiente e inovador para liderar a estratégia de dados e a execução técnica. Esta função envolve liderar uma equipe de profissionais de dados, discutir arquiteturas de dados robustas e garantir a entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta qualidade que impulsionam a inteligência de negócios e a eficiência operacional.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar e orientar uma equipe de engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e analistas de dados, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
  • Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lakes, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka).
  • Colaborar com produtos, engenharia, e equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados.
  • Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados.
  • Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roteiro de dados de longo prazo.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica.


  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência liderando projetos de dados.


  • Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java).


  • Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável.


  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas.


  • Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides

title: Cloud Engineer (DevOps/SRE) (Colombia, Brazil, Costa Rica)
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

We’re looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong DevOps/SRE experience to join a high-performing engineering team.


Role Overview

This engineer will be responsible for all of the infrastructure and tooling.

In this role, you will support cloud infrastructure and deploy pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform .

You’ll collaborate with senior engineers to automate infrastructure provisioning, manage containerized applications, and maintain CI/CD workflows to ensure reliable, scalable deployments across multi-cloud platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation and respond to incidents professionally
  • Maintain and enhance AWS cloud infrastructure using automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines , enabling self-service and agile software development
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to solve complex infrastructure and reliability challenges
  • Continuously improving system performance, reliability, and observability


Required Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure roles
  • Experience with AWK and Kubernetes is required.
  • Strong experience with AWS or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres or MySQL)
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch)
  • Ability to collaborate with teams working in PST time zone


Nice to Have

  • Programming experience beyond shell scripting (Go, Python, Java, etc.)
  • Experience debugging Kubernetes networking or performance issues
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS, etc.)
  • UNIX/Linux systems knowledge
  • Computer Science or Engineering degree

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.


Nossos benefícios:


O Que Temos Para Você

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.


Nossos benefícios:


O Que Temos Para Você

Atuar na resolução de incidentes e troubleshooting (nível 2 e 3)

Realizar atualizações, backups e documentação da infraestrutura

Apoiar projetos de expansão ou migração de rede



Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack (JavaScript, React, Node.js)
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Typescript | React | Node


Modelo de contratação: PJ (sem benefícios)

Trabalho: 100% remoto

⏱ Dedicação: Fulltime


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Frontend (React/Next.js)

  • Desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas com forte integração de APIs
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando hooks nativos do React (useState, useEffect, useContext, useCallback, useMemo)
  • Gerenciar estado global com Zustand
  • Trabalhar com TanStack Query para consumo eficiente de APIs
  • Utilizar shadcn/ui e Tailwind CSS para componentes


Backend (Node.js/Fastify)

  • Construir e manter APIs RESTful
  • Trabalhar com Drizzle ORM e PostgreSQL
  • Integrar serviços externos (Buckets, RabbitMQ)
Stack Tecnológica

Frontend

  • Next.js + React
  • TypeScript
  • Zustand (gerenciamento de estado)
  • TanStack Query
  • shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS


Backend

  • Node.js + TypeScript
  • Fastify
  • Drizzle ORM
  • PostgreSQL
  • RabbitMQ
  • Integração com Buckets/Storage
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de React (hooks, contexts, gerenciamento de estado)
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs REST
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL)
Diferenciais
  • Docker
  • Python (manipulação de arquivos)
  • Experiência com message brokers (RabbitMQ)

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Description

Join codevista as an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript in a fully remote role. Build and maintain web applications using modern JavaScript technologies like React and Node.js. Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere in Brazil, with collaborative tools and a supportive team environment tailored for beginners eager to grow their skills.

As an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript at codevista, you'll dive into the exciting world of web development while working remotely from anywhere in Brazil. This role is perfect for recent graduates or those with basic programming experience who are passionate about JavaScript and ready to contribute to real-world projects.

Your primary responsibilities will include developing user-facing features using frontend frameworks like React or Vue.js, integrating with backend services built on Node.js and Express, and working with databases such as MongoDB or PostgreSQL. You'll collaborate on building scalable web applications, fixing bugs, and optimizing performance for our clients' needs. Since this is an entry-level position, expect hands-on guidance from senior developers to help you learn best practices in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

Remote work is at the core of our setup at codevista. You'll use tools like Slack for daily communication, Zoom for team meetings and stand-ups, and Jira or Trello for task tracking. We foster a collaborative culture through virtual pair programming sessions and weekly knowledge-sharing calls, ensuring you're never isolated despite the distance. Time zones are considered, with core hours aligned to São Paulo time for seamless teamwork.

Technologies you'll work with include HTML5, CSS3 (with preprocessors like Sass), JavaScript (ES6+), and RESTful APIs. On the backend, you'll handle authentication, data validation, and deployment using platforms like Heroku or AWS basics. For an entry-level role, we emphasize learning over perfection—expect mentorship to build your foundational skills in full-stack development.

This position offers a supportive environment to grow your career. You'll participate in code reviews to understand clean code principles and contribute to open-source inspired projects internally. Remote flexibility means you can balance work with personal life, while our team ensures regular feedback to accelerate your professional development. Join us to turn your JavaScript passion into a rewarding remote career at codevista.

Requirements

  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (e.g., React) and backend runtime (e.g., Node.js)
  • Understanding of REST APIs and basic database concepts
  • Strong self-motivation and time management skills for independent remote work
  • Excellent communication abilities for virtual team collaboration
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

  • Realizar atividades de linha de produção de produtos embalados: tais como manuseio de embalagens para montagem,
  • Inspeção e colocação em esteira de produção; atividades de fechamento de baldes;
  • Selagens de sacos plásticos, fechamento de caixas, montagem de paletes com produtos acabados e plastificação de paletes.
  • Limpeza das instalações e equipamentos da área produtiva e afins; Preenchimento de planilhas relacionadas as atividades;
  • Organização das áreas produtivas; Garantir os procedimentos de BPF;
  • E outras atividades correlatas ao cargo.


Instrução:

  • Ensino Médio

Diferencial:

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. description:

  • Strong SQL skills (data warehousing context)

title: System Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • - Server Hardware Management
  • - Virtualization, especially VMware
  • - Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • - Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • - Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Projetos de TI para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia, garantindo entregas dentro de prazo, escopo, qualidade e orçamento. Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir projetos de sistemas, integrações, desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura ou transformação digital, atuando como elo entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade de organização, liderança e comunicação, capaz de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplos stakeholders.

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Vendedor(a) - Outlet
description:
Quem somos?

A Breton construiu uma história sólida e se tornou referência no mercado de mobiliário de alto padrão. A trajetória da empresa é marcada pela sofisticação, design diferenciado e compromisso com a responsabilidade ambiental e social, sendo reconhecida como uma das principais referências do segmento no Brasil.

Pautada pelos valores de família e conduzida por uma família, a marca tem expertise na criação, desenvolvimento e produção de mobiliário com alto valor agregado, que passa por uma curadoria afiada de uma equipe multidisciplinar preparada para atender as mais diversas demandas de um mercado exigente e que se moderniza a todo momento.

A Breton assume sua responsabilidade com a sustentabilidade e está comprometida em adotar práticas em todas as etapas de sua cadeia produtiva, buscando um melhor aproveitamento dos recursos naturais. Uma das conquistas da marca é o selo Carbono Negativo, obtido pela primeira vez, em 2022. Nos anos de 2020 e 2021 a Breton já era reconhecida como Carbono Neutro, ou seja, compensou todas as suas emissões.

Com 20 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil, o principal diferencial da Breton é a personalização. Cada peça é 100% personalizável, oferecendo aos clientes a escolha entre medidas, tecidos e acabamentos.

Saiba mais em ou @bretonoficial.


Na Breton , acreditamos que cada ambiente conta uma história.

Com design, sofisticação e cuidado em cada detalhe, buscamos transformar a experiência dos nossos clientes, oferecendo móveis que unem beleza, conforto e exclusividade.

No nosso Outlet , oferecemos peças especiais do nosso portfólio com condições diferenciadas, e buscamos alguém que, assim como nós, tenha brilho nos olhos para encantar clientes e transformar atendimentos em experiências memoráveis.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Receber e atender clientes na loja, apresentando as peças disponíveis no showroom e no estoque.
  • Apoiar o cliente na escolha de produtos, oferecendo informações e transmitindo confiança.
  • Realizar vendas e registrar pedidos no sistema, acompanhando todo o processo até a entrega.
  • Manter a organização do espaço de loja e auxiliar no controle do estoque.
  • Contribuir para que a experiência Breton seja percebida em cada detalhe, do primeiro contato ao pós-venda.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em vendas no varejo (móveis, decoração ou segmentos de luxo serão um diferencial).
  • Formação em Administração, Arquitetura, Design de Interiores ou áreas correlatas (completo ou em andamento);
  • Facilidade de comunicação, simpatia e vontade de encantar.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.
  • Conhecimento básico de informática.


Diferenciais que contam pontos:


  • Vivência em lojas de alto padrão.
  • Afinidade com design e interiores.
  • Paixão por criar conexões verdadeiras com pessoas.


  • Local de atuação: Outlet Breton – Pinheiros /SP.

Pautada pelos valores de família e conduzida por uma família, a marca tem expertise na criação, desenvolvimento e produção de mobiliário com alto valor agregado, que passa por uma curadoria afiada de uma equipe multidisciplinar preparada para atender as mais diversas demandas de um mercado exigente e que se moderniza a todo momento.

A Breton assume sua responsabilidade com a sustentabilidade e está comprometida em adotar práticas em todas as etapas de sua cadeia produtiva, buscando um melhor aproveitamento dos recursos naturais. Uma das conquistas da marca é o selo Carbono Negativo, obtido pela primeira vez, em 2022. Nos anos de 2020 e 2021 a Breton já era reconhecida como Carbono Neutro, ou seja, compensou todas as suas emissões.

Com 20 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil, o principal diferencial da Breton é a personalização. Cada peça é 100% personalizável, oferecendo aos clientes a escolha entre medidas, tecidos e acabamentos.

Saiba mais em ou @bretonoficial.


Na Breton , acreditamos que cada ambiente conta uma história.

Com design, sofisticação e cuidado em cada detalhe, buscamos transformar a experiência dos nossos clientes, oferecendo móveis que unem beleza, conforto e exclusividade.

No nosso Outlet , oferecemos peças especiais do nosso portfólio com condições diferenciadas, e buscamos alguém que, assim como nós, tenha brilho nos olhos para encantar clientes e transformar atendimentos em experiências memoráveis.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Receber e atender clientes na loja, apresentando as peças disponíveis no showroom e no estoque.
  • Apoiar o cliente na escolha de produtos, oferecendo informações e transmitindo confiança.
  • Realizar vendas e registrar pedidos no sistema, acompanhando todo o processo até a entrega.
  • Manter a organização do espaço de loja e auxiliar no controle do estoque.
  • Contribuir para que a experiência Breton seja percebida em cada detalhe, do primeiro contato ao pós-venda.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em vendas no varejo (móveis, decoração ou segmentos de luxo serão um diferencial).
  • Formação em Administração, Arquitetura, Design de Interiores ou áreas correlatas (completo ou em andamento);
  • Facilidade de comunicação, simpatia e vontade de encantar.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.
  • Conhecimento básico de informática.


Diferenciais que contam pontos:


  • Vivência em lojas de alto padrão.
  • Afinidade com design e interiores.
  • Paixão por criar conexões verdadeiras com pessoas.


  • Local de atuação: Outlet Breton – Pinheiros /SP.

title: SiteCore Developer
description:
We are looking for a Sitecore Developer Developer for a 100% Remote, 5 month +, 1099 contract


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Sitecore Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise-level CMS and commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Sitecore 8 and 9.x , C# , and the .NET Framework , with a proven ability to build scalable, high-performance solutions in complex enterprise environments.

This role involves working on both modernization initiatives and ongoing support of legacy Sitecore implementations while ensuring code quality, scalability, and system reliability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Sitecore MVC solutions for enterprise CMS and commerce platforms
  • Build and maintain custom Sitecore APIs and integrations
  • Support and modernize legacy Sitecore environments
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, and code quality best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust digital solutions
  • Contribute to Sitecore version upgrades and platform migrations


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Extensive experience developing Sitecore MVC solutions in enterprise environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sitecore 8 and Sitecore 9.3
  • Experience with Sitecore Commerce (add-on)
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Framework
  • Experience working with Sitecore APIs
  • Experience developing or supporting Azure web services (JavaScript-based)
  • Proven experience maintaining and upgrading legacy Sitecore platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience migrating between Sitecore versions
  • Experience with Node.js migrations
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments and deployment best practices
  • SiteCore Certifications

title: System Architect (Design System)
description:
Client Summary – Client Corporation

Client Corporation is a global power management leader with a commitment to innovation, reliability, and sustainability. With operations in more than 175 countries, Client designs technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and performance across industrial, electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. As Client expands its digital ecosystem, the company is investing heavily in enterprise architecture, design systems, cloud modernization, and scalable platforms. This role sits at the core of Client’s digital experience strategy and helps shape the future of UI frameworks, enterprise applications, and design consistency across global teams.


Job Description – System Architect (Design System)

Client: Client Corporation

Position: System Architect – Design System

Location: Remote / Hybrid (per Client requirements)


Position Overview

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

title: TIBCO EBX Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Java development, ideally applied within TIBCO EBX extensions or customizations;
  • Hands‑on experience developing on TIBCO EBX (data modeling, workflows, services, UI configuration, data quality rules);
  • Understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) processes and governance, especially in EBX contexts;
  • English B2;
  • Must relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal and in here will be 2x on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send apply!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:
About You

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. You thrive in structured environments, value best practices, and take ownership of delivering reliable, well-documented systems. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and feel comfortable supporting, maintaining, and evolving complex business applications.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (mandatory and up to date, with annual renewal).
  • Strong experience developing and customizing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) solutions.
  • Solid understanding of D365 F&O architecture, development lifecycle, and best practices.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations using Azure Data Factory for ETL and data synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience using Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and maintenance.
  • Ability to collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for production and non-production environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications based on business requirements.
  • Design, build, and support data integrations using Azure Data Factory, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
  • Use Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) to manage deployments, monitor environments, and support application health.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional consultants, developers, business users) to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for D365 F&O applications.
  • Document technical designs, configurations, integrations, and operational processes.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of D365 F&O solutions.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Data Engineer (Apache NIFI) Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Senior profile (minimum 5 years of professional experience)
  • Very strong data transformation skills , with proven hands-on experience in complex transformation scenarios.
  • Solid knowledge of XML , including advanced usage of XPath for data extraction, manipulation, and validation.
  • At least 2 years of eperience with Apache NIFI.
  • Good understanding of data integration concepts and flow-based programming.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
  • Fluent English
  • Williness to move to Portugal



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hibryd


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

title: Engenheiro de Exchange
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.



O que buscamos?

  • Especialista em Microsoft Exchange (On-Premises & Online) com foco em Segurança.


Principais responsabilidades técnicas:

  • Migração de Exchange On-Premises para Microsoft Exchange Online
  • Projetos e upgrades de Microsoft Exchange Server (2010, 2013, 2016, 2019)
  • Configuração híbrida, fluxo de e-mail (SMTP), DAG, alta disponibilidade e disaster recovery
  • Configuração de MX apontando para EOP ou gateways de terceiros
  • Scripting avançado em PowerShell
  • Health checks, troubleshooting avançado e recomendações de boas práticas


Infraestrutura & Identidade:

  • Arquitetura e administração de Active Directory (2008/2016)
  • Experiência sólida em ambientes on-premises
  • Cluster de Failover
  • Experiência comprovada em múltiplos projetos (mín. 5 anos em arquitetura, implantação e suporte)


Segurança e Compliance (diferencial importante):

  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (políticas de higiene de e-mail, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Threat Explorer, Quarantine, Advanced Hunting)
  • Microsoft Purview (retenção, rótulos de sensibilidade, DLP, eDiscovery; diferenciais: Insider Risk, Information Barriers e Communication Compliance)



CLT FULL + Benefícios

Contrato híbrido para **eventuais** viagens e visitas a cliente.


O que oferecemos?


· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.



“O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).”

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
  • Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
  • Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
  • Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
  • Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
  • Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
  • Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercises


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.
